{{Top|leg}}
The '''Melan clan''' was a clan of [[Nyriaanan]]s, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. The clan's elders were responsible for overseeing and administering [[Starveil (settlement)|Starveil]], the largest native settlement on the planet.
